headline: EPS surges year-over-year and sequentially
summary_short: Fujikura reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of ¥48.58, up 156.8% y/y from ¥18.92.
summary_long: Basic EPS of ¥48.58 rose 156.8% year-over-year from ¥18.92, and jumped 77.8% sequentially from ¥27.32 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
